note: Official image shortlist for approval (nothing downloaded into the project). Sources: marvel.com and cdn.marvel.com, d23.com, thewaltdisneycompany.com. For cdn.marvel.com assets the imageUrl is the original-resolution JPEG (content/2x/<name>.jpg); the pages themselves display a WebP of the same asset capped at 2000 px wide. Width, height and bytes come from a ranged request (first 64 KB) per file. No official Doomsday character posters exist on any Marvel or Disney web page as of this date: the six Doomsday posters on marvel.com are Doom-only or logo-only, and the July 2026 trailer stills (Cyclops, Mystique, Gambit and Shang-Chi, Thor and Steve, group shots) were issued to press only. subjectCount "several" means a group too large or partly hidden to count reliably.

foundOnXNotFetched.what: Korean international Avengers: Doomsday poster (Doom over Thor, Steve Rogers, Sam Wilson, Bucky, Yelena, Shuri, Reed Richards, Professor X, Cyclops, Gambit; Loki teased), as reported by The Direct. Not on any Marvel or Disney web page found.

Marvel Studios X account: reported source of the SDCC Malaga "Doom and the Latverian witches" poster, the LEGO chess poster, a seven-hero line-up poster (Oct 2026) and Disney+ countdown posters (which reuse older art). Exact post URLs not known; not fetched.

notOfficial: Leads seen but excluded as not official sources: hexfacility.com "25 posters" (Oct 2026), Andy Park concept art posted on his own X account (he has left Marvel Studios), leaked set and toy photos, fan posters.
